== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited face uses character ability, says a character may be immediately captured, and says a creature is immediately lost. Decipher’s November 1998 Glossary names both target types, uses defense value for the character check, and omits the earlier may and immediately wording. The Revised article stays in Versions as a separate printing.
